<thought>The ¹H NMR shows only two singlets: 3 H at 1.79 ppm and 6 H at 1.93 ppm, indicating three methyl groups with no neighboring protons. This pattern matches a molecule that has a carbonyl‑attached methyl (3 H) and a gem‑dimethyl group attached to the carbonyl carbon (6 H). The simplest structure fitting this description is 2,2‑dimethylacetyl (tert‑butyl methyl ketone), whose SMILES is “CC(C)(C)C(=O)C”.</thought>
<final_answer>CC(C)(C)C(=O)C</final_answer>
